Adrien Rabiot.note: Rabiot has been France's quiet balance in midfield. He keeps the left side sturdy, then sneaks forward late enough to become the extra runner.
Adrien Rabiot.noteZh: 拉比奥是法国中场安静的平衡点。他让左侧更稳，也会在合适的时机后插上，成为多出来的接应点。

Aurelien Tchouameni.note: Tchouameni anchors France when the game starts stretching. He wins the first duel and can turn it into the longer pass that sends the forwards running.
Aurelien Tchouameni.noteZh: 楚阿梅尼在比赛被拉开时稳住法国中场。他先赢下第一下对抗，再用更长的传球把前锋送出去。

Bradley Barcola.note: Barcola keeps giving France width on the left. He can beat the full-back, reach the end line, and pull the ball back for a runner.
Bradley Barcola.noteZh: 巴尔科拉不断给法国左路拉开宽度。他能过掉边后卫，冲到底线附近，再把球回传给跟进的队友。

Brice Samba.note: Samba is the experienced keeper France can turn to if Maignan is unavailable. His card is about command, reach, and comfort in traffic.
Brice Samba.noteZh: 如果迈尼昂无法出场，桑巴是法国可以依靠的经验门将。他的看点是指挥、覆盖范围，以及在人群中处理球的稳定。

Dayot Upamecano.note: Upamecano lets France defend with space behind them. He steps into duels early, then has the speed to recover if the first challenge does not finish the play.
Dayot Upamecano.noteZh: 于帕梅卡诺让法国敢在身后留出空间。他会提前上抢，如果第一下没有解决问题，也有速度回追。

Desire Doue.note: Doue is the young attacker France use to change the rhythm on the left. He receives in tight pockets and tries the touch that makes a defender turn.
Desire Doue.noteZh: 杜埃是法国用来改变左路节奏的年轻攻击手。他能在狭小区域接球，并用第一下触球迫使防守者转身。

Ibrahima Konate.note: Konate is the centre-back France can add when the match becomes about crosses, contact, and protecting a lead.
Ibrahima Konate.noteZh: 当比赛变成传中、身体对抗和守住领先时，科纳特是法国可以换上的中卫。

Jean-Philippe Mateta.note: Mateta is France's late-game target. If the match gets direct, he gives Mbappe a rest and gives crosses a bigger body to find.
Jean-Philippe Mateta.noteZh: 马特塔是法国比赛后段的支点。如果比赛变得更直接，他能让姆巴佩休息，也让传中有更强壮的目标。

Jules Kounde.note: Kounde is the quiet lock on France's right side. He holds the flank steady so the front four can take more risks ahead of him.
Jules Kounde.noteZh: 孔德是法国右侧安静的锁。他把边路守稳，让身前的四名攻击手可以承担更多风险。

Kylian Mbappe.note: Mbappe is still France's game breaker, but this tournament has also been about how quickly others find him. If he receives facing goal before the defense is set, the whole back line starts retreating.
Kylian Mbappe.noteZh: 姆巴佩依然是法国打破比赛的人，但这届世界杯也在考验队友多快能找到他。如果他在防线站稳前面对球门接球，整条后防线都会开始后退。

Lucas Digne.note: Digne has become France's steadier left-back choice in the knockout run. He offers early service and calmer defending while Hernandez waits as the power option.
Lucas Digne.noteZh: 迪涅在淘汰赛阶段成了法国更稳的左后卫选择。他提供早传和更冷静的防守，而埃尔南德斯保留着力量型选择。

Lucas Hernandez.note: Lucas Hernandez is the harder defensive version on the left. France can use him when the flank needs bite more than extra attacking runs.
Lucas Hernandez.noteZh: 卢卡斯·埃尔南德斯是左侧更强硬的防守版本。当边路更需要硬度而不是更多前插时，法国可以使用他。

Maghnes Akliouche.note: Akliouche is a late attacking craft option for France. His appeal is the small touch near the box that turns a safe possession spell into a chance.
Maghnes Akliouche.noteZh: 阿克利乌什是法国比赛后段的细腻进攻选择。他的价值在于禁区附近的小触球，能把安全控球变成机会。

Malo Gusto.note: Gusto is the right-back France use when Kounde's side needs fresh legs. He can push high, then still sprint back into the wide duel.
Malo Gusto.noteZh: 当孔德这一侧需要新鲜体能时，古斯托是法国的右后卫选择。他能压上，也能再冲刺回到边路对抗。

Manu Kone.note: Kone has become one of France's legs in midfield. He carries through contact and helps the press start again after the ball is lost.
Manu Kone.noteZh: 科内已经成为法国中场的跑动腿。他能带球穿过对抗，也能在丢球后帮助球队再次压迫。

Marcus Thuram.note: Thuram gives France a forward who can drift wide without leaving the box empty. He is a late-game way to add running power around Mbappe.
Marcus Thuram.noteZh: 图拉姆让法国拥有一个能拉边但不让禁区空掉的前锋。他是比赛后段在姆巴佩身边增加跑动冲击的选择。

Maxence Lacroix.note: Lacroix is France's pace cover at centre-back. He is there for games where the defensive line has to live high and still survive the ball over the top.
Maxence Lacroix.noteZh: 拉克鲁瓦是法国中卫位置的速度保险。当防线必须站得很高，还要防住身后球时，他就有价值。

Michael Olise.note: Olise has become France's pass before the panic. He receives between midfield and attack, then waits just long enough for Mbappe or Barcola to run.
Michael Olise.noteZh: 奥利塞已经成了法国制造慌乱前的那脚传球。他在中场和锋线之间接球，然后等到姆巴佩或巴尔科拉跑出时机再出球。

Mike Maignan.note: Maignan is the calm base behind France's high line. His range and distribution let the defenders play forward without every turnover feeling like an emergency.
Mike Maignan.noteZh: 迈尼昂是法国高位防线身后的冷静底座。他的覆盖范围和出球能力，让后卫敢向前踢，而不是每次丢球都像警报。

Ngolo Kante.note: Kante is the emergency brake France can still call on in midfield. Even now, his best trait is seeing the counter before it looks like one.
Ngolo Kante.noteZh: 坎特依然是法国中场可以启用的紧急刹车。即使现在，他最强的特质仍是能在反击成形前就看见危险。

Ousmane Dembele.note: Dembele has been France's chaos button on the right. He can shoot with either foot, and Norway found out how quickly one good spell can become a hat trick.
Ousmane Dembele.noteZh: 登贝莱是法国右侧的混乱按钮。他左右脚都能射门，挪威已经见识到一段好状态能多快变成帽子戏法。

Rayan Cherki.note: Cherki is the bench player for strange endings. When the shape loosens, he wants the ball at his feet and the pass nobody else is brave enough to try.
Rayan Cherki.noteZh: 谢尔基是法国应对奇怪收尾阶段的替补。当阵型开始松动时，他想要球在脚下，也敢传别人不敢尝试的球。

Robin Risser.note: Risser is France's developmental goalkeeper in this squad. The card matters mostly as depth behind Maignan and Samba, not as a likely match story yet.
Robin Risser.noteZh: 里塞尔是法国这支名单里的培养型门将。他目前更像迈尼昂和桑巴身后的深度，而不是马上会成为比赛主线的人。

Theo Hernandez.note: Theo Hernandez is the left-back who changes the speed of France's attack. One regain can become a carry that drags the whole team upfield.
Theo Hernandez.noteZh: 特奥·埃尔南德斯是能改变法国进攻速度的左后卫。一次夺回球权，就可能变成把全队带上去的推进。

Warren Zaire-Emery.note: Zaire-Emery is the midfield reset option if France need fresher legs and cleaner circulation. His value is keeping attacks moving without making the game louder.
Warren Zaire-Emery.noteZh: 如果法国需要更新鲜的体能和更干净的中场流转，扎伊尔-埃梅里是重置选择。他的价值是让进攻继续运转，而不把比赛变得更吵。

William Saliba.note: Saliba is the calm that lets France play with so much attacking talent ahead of him. He wins duels without making the whole defense look hurried.
William Saliba.noteZh: 萨利巴的冷静让法国敢在身前摆出那么多进攻天才。他能赢下对抗，而不让整条防线显得慌张。
